newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal hikes IBM shr target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal hikes IBM shr target.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst David Takata said he is raising his price target on International Business Machines Corp to $200, which is about 15 times his 1997 earnings estimates.
-- Takata said he is maintaining his 1997 earnings estimates for IBM of $13.00 a share, and introducing an estimate of $14.09 for 1998.

-- Takata said Gruntal believes IBM is widely seen as capable of maintaining its position as the high-end server company and in an age of networked computers, this position is increasingly attractive.
